analyst_view.overall: Early view: Espanyol (13th) are now coached by Eder Sarabia, who replaced the sacked Manolo González in late October and wants a possession and pressing game. Celta (11th) play away at Marseille in the Europa League on the Thursday before this Sunday trip, so fatigue and rotation are likely. Espanyol striker Kike García is out until around December.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals. Two things pull in opposite directions: Celta's tired legs after Marseille could open the game, but Espanyol may still lack Kike García's goals. I stay with the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners. I lean higher: Sarabia's sides keep the ball and push full-backs high, and a Celta side coming off a Thursday away game is likely to spend long spells defending.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. Nothing specific points either way; no referee yet and no particular rivalry.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.5 shots. I lean slightly higher: Sarabia's pressing should give Espanyol more shots at home than under the previous coach, especially against a Celta side short of rest.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.7 shots on target. More Espanyol shots may not mean better ones while their main striker is still returning, so I stay with the model.
